label: Late-episode D1 after landing in S2, policy leaning a1
explanation: Fires only at D1 (never GO or D2) and only late in the episode: nothing before trial ~55, rising steeply through trials 70-99. In those windows it is concentrated on D1 steps where the previous trial reached S2 (an a1 rare or a2 common transition; it also fires at the window-initial D1, where the previous state is not in the window), the model value is low (<7.1), and the D1 policy logit a1-a2 is mildly to moderately positive (-1.5..8). It is enriched after unrewarded trials and before switches (often switching back to a1), but those are not required. The predicate uses only observed or computed quantities: previous state, episode position, and the model own logit. It captures about 98% of activation mass but precision is only about 12%, so most late-episode D1-after-S2 steps stay silent; I found no further observed variable that sharpened it. Using the upcoming action a1 instead of the logit raised precision to about 18% but cut recall to 58%. Magnitude is largest in the latest trials, and the top examples are D1 after an unrewarded a2->S2 common trial, followed by a switch to a1.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over trial before (D1: a1 S1 u, a1 S2 u, a2 S2 u) and last trial (D1: a1 S2 u, a1 S2 r, a2 S2 u); timing cues that raise it most: phase=D1 & ep_dec=9, phase=D1 & ep_dec=8, phase=D1 & ep_dec=7.
